name: omaslack
author: Scabb Island
description: Slack for Omarchy, from the bar and from the terminal, on one local daemon: unread badges, a quick-view panel with quick replies, and a full window.

barWidget.description: Slack unread badges and quick access to the omaslack window and terminal client.

schema.label: Channel badge
schema.description: Show a second badge for unread channels and threads.

schema.label: Main badge counts
schema.description: What the main badge counts: DMs and mentions aimed at you, or every unread conversation.

schema.label: Open conversations in
schema.description: Where right-clicking the icon or picking a conversation in the panel opens it.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is unread
schema.description: The icon takes no space in the bar while nothing is unread.
